title: Pitya Ukhma (black pot)

paragraphs: R' Nachman so called Rav Eina in Pesachim 88; R' Assi so called R' Zeira in Avodah Zarah 16a; and Rava so called Rafram bar Papa in Berakhot 53a.[^1]

notes.text: Black pot is the lexical vessel epithet, not the superseded black pitch. It is applied to three recipients, not a single-person identity. ר״נ/ר״ז are contextually Nachman/Zeira, with titles R'; Assi’s abbreviated title likewise remains R'. Eina’s full רב remains Rav; Rava and Rafram are unprefixed names. Pesachim פח, has no side marker; טז./נג. give 16a/53a conventionally, without fresh checks. All three caller/recipient directions and repeated so-called force remain.
